tbesh_html:
1) to be or become sweet or pleasing
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to be or become sweet
1a2) to be or become pleasant
1a3) to suck
1b) (Hiphil) to give sweet taste
Also means: ma.taq (מָתָק "to sweeten" H4988)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to suck, by implication, to relish, or (intransitively) be sweet
